properties.displayName: HVMC - Security logging disabled or deleted
properties.description: A diagnostic setting, flow log, alert rule or the Log Analytics workspace was deleted, or a Defender plan was downgraded to Free - possible defence evasion. Risk R01. Playbook PB-04.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| extend Body = tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody)
| where OperationNameValue in~ ('MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/DELETE','MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKWATCHERS/FLOWLOGS/DELETE','MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/ACTIVITYLOGALERTS/DELETE','MICROSOFT.OPERATIONALINSIGHTS/WORKSPACES/DELETE')
    or (OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.SECURITY/PRICINGS/WRITE' and Body has '"pricingTier":"Free"')
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, _ResourceId, CorrelationId
